title: Retail commerce Production schema baseline environment isolation regression

phases.objective: Prove that the missing BACKEND_API_KEY regression is isolated from any GitHub Environment binding and restores the process environment after the assertion.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Retail commerce Production schema baseline contract test on the exact candidate head
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The true missing-key case fails closed even when the parent runner has a BACKEND_API_KEY binding, and the original process environment is restored without exposing the secret value.
steps: Preserve whether BACKEND_API_KEY was present in the test process.
Remove the binding only for the missing-key assertion.
Assert that the collector rejects the absent runtime key before any Production operation.
Restore the original process environment in a finally block.
Retain all SELECT-only, no-row-data, no-mutation, and no-secret-return assertions.
assertions: The regression does not log, return, compare, or persist the BACKEND_API_KEY value.
The missing-key assertion cannot fall through to a GitHub Environment binding.
The process environment is restored after both success and failure paths.
No Production connection, SQL execution, migration apply, row-data read, deployment, restart, or external send is performed by this synthetic test.

phases.objective: Retain the isolated missing-key regression in the canonical ordered test suite.
Exercise restoration behavior across assertion and adapter failures.
Revalidate the contract in a separately authorized read-only baseline trigger after protected-main integration.
Require exact-main tooling and separate authorization before any Production schema baseline read.
